hypothesis: Align spacing tokens to strict 4pt grid, replace 2 heavy inline shadows with design system tokens, reduce shadow opacity, standardize mobile CTA padding — all measurable via token compliance count and shadow opacity values

Add --shadow-elevated and --shadow-float design tokens for single elevation policy
Replace .guided-dialog heavy shadow (0 20px 50px, opacity 0.12) with --shadow-elevated token (0 8px 32px, opacity 0.06)
Replace .mobile-cta hardcoded padding (10px 12px) with grid-aligned tokens, lighten shadow from 0.06 to 0.04
